phase: Global waveform M3 step-size sensitivity after development screen
rule: parent + global_step*(original validation-selected M3 prediction-parent). Same step for all datasets, folds, cells and four parent combinations.
selection: No per-dataset or per-cell step selection. Report all16 sensitivity candidates; any adoption is exploratory development selection and needs separate stability/verification.
limits: Motivated by observed development overcorrection; not independent preregistration
No new source labels or GP fits
Ordinary shrinkage is not a novelty claim
